intro: Why do we ask for donations? Well, quite frankly, it’s a bit expensive to meet with key members of important organzations to introduce them to the needs of Submariners.
transparency_intro: What exactly are we spending your donations on?

transparency.label: Travel:
transparency.text: Providing resources and assistance to families, ensuring they have the support they need while their loved ones are away.

transparency.label: Business Operations:
transparency.text: Funding educational programs and training to enhance the skills and career opportunities of submariners.

stories: Do you have a story of how the Submariners’ Advocacy Group has helped you or someone you know?
how: We have partnered with Zeffy to make donating easy and secure. Use the form below to donate to the Submariners’ Advocacy Group.

help.label: Volunteer:
help.text: Join our team and help us support submariners and their families.

sub.label: Researchers:
sub.text: Help us gather information and data to support our mission.

sub.label: Report Writers:
sub.text: Help us create reports and white papers to share with key members of Congress and other organizations.

sub.label: Technology Expertise:
sub.text: Website development, social media management, web application development, and more…

sub.label: Public Relations:
sub.text: Help us spread the word about our mission and the needs of submariners.

help.label: Advocacy:
help.text: Help us meet with key members of Congress and other organizations to advocate for submariners.

help.label: Spread the Word:
help.text: Share our mission with your friends and family to increase awareness and support.
